mainEntity.name: What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for real estate agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for real estate agents focuses on making your property listings, agent profiles, and local market expertise easily discoverable and consumable by AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. Unlike traditional SEO that aims for website clicks, AEO structures your content to directly answer user queries within these new search interfaces. This ensures your information is presented immediately to potential clients seeking homes, agent services, or local market data, increasing your visibility and lead generation in an evolving search landscape.
